name: QA PR Learning
description: Lets QA learn from the persistent PR-comment log to surface team-specific review patterns during its own reviews.

learningEnabled.label: Learning Enabled
learningEnabled.description: Master switch for the PR-comment learning loop. When on (default), QA reads the comment log before each review and uses found patterns to inform findings. When off, QA relies solely on the in-session diff.

logSourcePath.label: Log Source Path
logSourcePath.description: Path to the PR-comment log QA reads from. Empty defers to integration.bitbucket-pr-comments' log path. Set explicitly only to point QA at a different log (e.g. a curated log or the reviewer-dossier).

patternExtractionMode.label: Pattern Extraction Mode
patternExtractionMode.description: How QA distills patterns from the log. recurring-themes (default): groups comments by topic, surfaces ones in 3+ comments. author-styles: indexes by reviewer. literal-quotes: surfaces past phrasings as exemplars.

minLogEntriesToActivate.label: Min Log Entries To Activate
minLogEntriesToActivate.description: Minimum log entries required before the learning loop activates; below this, QA reverts to non-learning behavior. Raise for stricter signal, lower for faster activation on new projects.

surfaceLearnedPatterns.label: Surface Learned Patterns
surfaceLearnedPatterns.description: When on, QA cites learned patterns by name in its verdict. When off, patterns inform findings internally without being cited — cleaner verdicts for established teams.
